Subject: Welcome to Redwood — quick 30‑min walkthrough options

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for a trial — welcome! I run SDR engagement for trial accounts and I can get you a short technical walkthrough to make sure your team can get inference running quickly. We typically do a 30‑minute session that covers: integration path (API or Private), a quick runthrough of latency/cost controls, and any specific questions about security or data flows.

Pick a time that works best for you: https://cal.redwood.ai/kimberly_park/30
Or if you prefer, reply with 2-3 time windows (PST) and I’ll block something. I can also loop in an engineer for a deeper demo — let me know if you want an engineer present.

Quick ask so the session is useful: can you paste a one-line summary of your primary use-case (e.g., "embedding search for analytics insights")?

Attached is a one-pager that summarizes the trial checklist and what we can cover.

—
